features: [4 Colorful Lighting Modes]: Not only do these kids bluetooth headphones give great audio, but they also have the added feature of coming with LED lights that have multiple effects and colors on both sides of the headset. Use with AUX or wireless for ultimate versatility!

[Bluetooth 5.2 & Built-In Mic]: Enjoy Bluetooth 5.2 technology with the iClever wireless kids headphones for a super-stable connection. One button controls play, pause, end and answer phone calls. The built-in microphone on these Kids over ear headphones gives hands-free freedom for studying, homework, being in class or playtime.
